title: 赛恩·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 庞大身形穿封闭铠甲，金属下颌护具与柔光胸甲形成厚重层次。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Sion has an immense adult humanoid frame, red-gray skin, a broad jaw, a metal lower-face guard, and heavy enclosed armor with a softly illuminated chest plate. Opaque cloth layers cover gaps between plates, while his huge axe remains a separate physical object with a broad metal head and thick shaft.
art_direction.scene: A broad full-body study, weight settled naturally on the feet or canonical support, expansive silhouette and an economical pale environment cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: iron gray, brick red, amber rim, blue; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
